selected_matches.summary: Accepted owner-preserving Augmentor blueprint with explicit source, context, routing, run, memory, reasoning, and authority boundaries; the complete runtime witness remains absent.

Accepted blueprint combines existing provider-owned sources, a disposable semantic index, bounded reasoning, grounded presentation, and visible user control while retaining unverified overhead and quality targets.
Candidate synthesis separates host-backed reads from owner-gated writes and treats typed ontology traversal as a read-path option whose cost moves toward ingest and curation.
Corrected candidate thesis says the stable citable typed referent plus recorded gate is the useful unit; determinism is a cost property, not an authority guarantee.

excluded_matches.reason: Useful for session and route ownership, but not the primary consultation request/response or evidence-record contract.
Strategy-only predecessor; the verified research-result entry is the stronger selected read model.
Domain-specific ontology relationship review; it does not own the Augmentor agent consultation API.
Presentation and retell precedent is useful later for UI wording, but it does not define an agent-callable API.

unresolved_gaps: No accepted consultation API or native agent-tool contract exists for this ontology.
The owner of a neutral runtime projection from the private ontology remains unselected.
Agent-answer quality, retrieval relevance, latency, token, and storage budgets are unmeasured.
The consumer product lacks a proven end-to-end context-to-query-to-answer witness.
Authentication identity, tenant scope, and field-level disclosure policy are not owner-approved.
design_consequences: Use a two-layer evidence API plus answering-agent adapter instead of coupling retrieval and prose generation.
Return stable source handles, selectors, status, freshness, confidence, owner, and claim ceiling with every evidence item.
Treat no match, insufficient evidence, conflict, stale evidence, denial, and budget exhaustion as distinct fail-closed outcomes.
Keep writes, trusted-memory intake, ontology admission, authority decisions, routing, and execution outside the consultation API.
Design against a neutral bounded projection rather than exposing the private ontology package or filesystem directly.
residue: Machine index source coverage is partial by design.
Inventory summaries are discovery leads and do not replace verification of owner-held sources during the confirmed Refine stages.
Operational confirmation-readiness terms were resolved from live repository skills rather than treated as API design evidence.
non_authority_notice: Inventory is a discovery read model. These matches shape context and questions; they do not authorize the API, define canonical meaning, admit memory, grant promotion, or prove implementation.
